theorem backend.takeWhile_eq_take_append {α : Type} (p : α → Bool) (l : List α) (m : Nat) (hall : ∀
    (k : Nat) (x : α), k < m → l[k]? = some x → p x = true) : List.takeWhile p l = List.take m l ++
    List.takeWhile p (List.drop m l)

    : backend.slicesAre ss bs ∗ ownSlice s b DFrac.discard ⊢ backend.slicesAre (ss ++ [s]) (bs ++
    [b])

theorem backend.takeWhile_take_eq {α : Type} (p : α → Bool) (l : List α) (m lim : Nat) (hall : ∀ (k
    : Nat) (x : α), k < m → l[k]? = some x → p x = true) (hle : m ≤ lim) (hend : m = l.length ∨ (∃
    x, l[m]? = some x ∧ p x = false) ∨ m = lim) : List.take lim (List.takeWhile p l) = List.take m l

theorem backend.swap_getElem? {α : Type} (l : List α) (i j : Nat) (x y : α) (hx : l[i]? = some x)
    (hy : l[j]? = some y) (k : Nat) : ((l.set j x).set i y)[k]? = l[backend.swapIdx i j k]?

theorem backend.wp_load_slot_val (sl : GoSlice) (i : Int) (kvs : List
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.kv) (dq : DFrac) (x :

    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.kv i sl))) {{ Φ }}

def backend.swapIdx (i j k : Nat) : Nat :=
  if k = i then j else if k = j then i else k

    (dq : DFrac) : typedPointsto l v dq ⊢ typedPointsto (structFieldRef

    l v dq)

theorem backend.bbRange_of_dropWhile_cons (es : List backend.Ent) (key endKey : GoString) (limit :
    w64) (e : backend.Ent) (rest : List backend.Ent) (h : List.dropWhile (fun e => decide
    (backend.strLt e.fst key)) es = e :: rest) : backend.bbRange es key endKey limit = if endKey =
    [] then if e.fst = key then [e] else [] else List.take (sint.Z limit).toNat (List.takeWhile (fun
    e => decide (backend.strLt e.fst endKey)) (e :: rest))

    l.length) (hall : ∀ (k : Nat) (x : α), k < m → l[k]? = some x → p x = true) (hstop : ∀ (x : α),
    l[m]? = some x → p x = false) : List.dropWhile p l = List.drop m l
